title: Follow up with Northstar SecureOps
subject: Re: X-Security: a question about endpoint operations
body:
Hi Divakar,

Thanks for proposing a meeting. I’m available at the time you suggested and look forward to speaking. Does the slot still work for you? If you have a few minutes before or after, we could do a brief 15‑minute discovery chat to explore your endpoint‑visibility and reporting goals.
